questions.stem: A 35-year-old male presented with left MTP joints pain, redness, and swelling for 6 hours. The joint fluid shows milky appearance, WBC 100,000 cell/µl (PMN 75%, Mono 25%), RBC 10,000 cell/µl, and crystals with negative birefringence. What is the diagnosis?
questions.explanation: ผลึก needle negative birefringence = monosodium urate ของ gout

option_why.A: Hemophilic arthropathy มี RBC มาก
option_why.B: RA ไม่มีผลึก
option_why.C: ✓ Gout
option_why.D: ไม่ใช่คำตอบที่ถูกต้องของโจทย์ข้อนี้
